notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list and OpenStreetMap name this tower; neither gives a build date, builder, height, staffing or access. The list has no NHLR or FFLOS entry for it. Two search rounds and reads found nothing about Siren itself. The Wisconsin Historical Society record HI234018 is the Grantsburg tower on State Highway 70 in Burnett County, not this one, and was not used. An FAA antenna registry snippet listed other towers in Siren; those were not verified on a readable page and are not used. The 2015 AP report does not name Siren, so its status under the statewide decision is unknown. Budget: 2 WebSearch, about 6 page reads. The story can be expanded if a Wisconsin Historical Society record or a Burnett County history is found.
